newsitem.title: UK: Sterling gains foothold vs mark after Q1 GDP data.
newsitem.headline: Sterling gains foothold vs mark after Q1 GDP data.

text.p: Sterling regained composure against the mark, hovering near peaks at midday after a lift from robust first-quarter gross domestic product (GDP) growth.
Preliminary GDP data showed the economy grew 1.0 percent quarter-on-quarter and 3.0 percent year-on-year against forecasts for an 0.9 percent and 2.9 percent rise, respectively.
Output in the UK services industries grew 1.2 percent quarter-on-quarter and 3.9 percent year/year.
"Clearly, they are strong numbers. We were looking for the pace of growth to remain basically unchanged," said Kevin Adams, UK strategist at BZW.
